data.raw_text:
2.42 billion people will have 0 access to fuel before the end of April...

Many of these countries are already implementing fuel rationing and even energy lockdowns!🤔

🇮🇳 India - 1.47B people - 10 days strategic reserve
🇦🇺 Australia — 27M people - 29 days of fuel left
🇹🇷 Turkey - 88M people - net importer, NO fuel
🇪🇬 Egypt - 117M people - 30 days of fuel left
🇧🇩 Bangladesh - 175M people - DAYS of fuel left
🇻🇳 Vietnam - 98M people — <20 days of fuel left
🇵🇰 Pakistan - 245M people - 20 days of fuel left
🇱🇧 Lebanon — 5.9M people — DAYS of fuel left
🇱🇰 Sri Lanka — 22M people — weeks of fuel left
🇲🇲 Myanmar — 55M people — days of fuel left
🇵🇭 Philippines — 115M people — ~60 days of fuel
🇰🇷 South Korea - 52M people - 110 days left

And don't forget it's not just oil, countries are beginning to struggle to import fertilizer and now food.

Globalization died in 2022, and so many countries and continents are going to struggle without imports, even if this crisis ends tomorrow.

The damage has been done, and if you're living in Europe, Asia, or the middle east, you need to rethink how that region will fare in a supply chain breakdown.
